newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NAB plans 13 million share buyback.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NAB plans 13 million share buyback.

text.p: National Austeralia Bank Ltd said on Thursday it planned to buyback about 13 million of its ordinary shares, representing 0.9 percent of the bank's issued capital, at an estimated cost of A$181 million.

"This initiative is evidence of the group's commitment to the timely and efficient utilisation of capital and confidence in its capacity to continue to generate strong earnings and capital growth," NAB managing director Don Argus said in a statement accompanying the bank's 1995/96 profit announcement.
Argus said the bank would continue to review all capital management initiatives which were consistent with the bank's acquisition strategy.
The buyback would have a positive impact on NAB's return on equity and earnings per share, Argus said.
NAB said the buyback represented the equivalent of the shares to be issued under its January 1997 dividend reinvestment bonus share and share top-up plans.
NAB shares were 23 cents higher at a record A$14.15 at 11.50 a.m. (0150 GMT) in response to its 6.8 percent rise in annual net profit to A$2.10 billion.
